just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on G in Daramad. The line peaks at Bb4 (435.5 Hz) at 1:40.1. It closes on Ek4, not the tonic (G4 → Fs4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → Ek4).
